Bedroom hotel-room or dressing-space depth and furnishing cues remain readable through the linen bed, bedside objects, mirror, slippers, and closed door. A visible window and translucent curtain create a broad directional gradient with soft-edged shadows across face, hair, dress, and room depth. The adult continues one concrete dressing grooming or room action rather than passive reclining, drawing the outer lapel inward while tying the waist. One garment sheet or curtain edge shows thickness overlap contact shadow and gravity, expressed by the weighted lapel and secured underlayer. Above the single diagonal lapel boundary, one shoulder and the collarbone remain visible while opaque fabric keeps the chest and lower body fully covered. Frame a vertical eye-level knee-up portrait with the window, curtain, hands, waist knot, bed, mirror, and closed door all plainly legible.
